title: Rethinking in Spikes: Mitigating Hallucinations in MDLMs with Step-Aware Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.12901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advancements in multimodal diffusion language models (MDLMs) have exhibited strong global modeling capabilities through iterative refinement. We observe that mask uncertainty follows an overall downward trend during iterative denoising, while a few denoising steps exhibit localized entropy spikes closely associated with hallucinations. We argue that anomalous steps can be identified by measuring the entropy deviation of each denoising step from its neighboring temporal window. We hypothesize that discrete token commitment discards the distributional information at masked positions, limiting the continued interaction between candidate semantics and the context during entropy spikes. With this goal, we present StepRefine, a plug-and-play decoding strategy that leverages semantic context to achieve reliable denoising. translated_title: 反思尖峰：通过步感知解码缓解多模态扩散语言模型中的幻觉
translated_abstract: 多模态扩散语言模型（MDLMs）的最新进展通过迭代精炼展现出了强大的全局建模能力。我们观察到，掩码不确定性在迭代去噪过程中呈现总体下降趋势，而少数去噪步骤表现出与幻觉密切相关的局部熵尖峰。我们认为，可以通过测量每个去噪步骤的熵与其相邻时间窗口的偏差来识别异常步骤。我们假设离散词元的承诺机制会丢弃掩码位置上的分布信息，从而限制了候选语义与上下文在熵尖峰期间的持续交互。为此，我们提出了StepRefine，一种利用语义上下文实现可靠去噪的即插即用解码策略。我们方法的核心在于在离散去噪与潜在精炼之间进行步感知切换。该模型采用……
tldr: 提出了StepRefine，一种即插即用的步感知解码策略，通过检测去噪过程中的熵尖峰并在离散去噪与潜在精炼之间动态切换，从而缓解多模态扩散语言模型的幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes StepRefine, a plug-and-play step-aware decoding strategy that detects entropy spikes during denoising and dynamically switches between discrete denoising and latent refinement to mitigate hallucinations in multimodal diffusion language models.
